steps.m: Jump through; bring the soles together and draw the heels under the perineum, turning the feet so the heels point forward; press the hands down and lift the chest

alignment: Turn the feet from the ankles gradually; never force the knees.
Lift the chest and keep the spine upright.
modifications: Sit on a blanket with the heels in front of the body.

nahusasana.note: Three lunge-based variations that differ in arm position (for example reverse prayer in A and Jnana Mudra in B). Teachers present these differently. Learn them from your teacher.

steps.m: From Down Dog, step the right foot forward into the lunge and take the arm position
Step the left foot forward and repeat
From Down Dog, lift into a forearm or hand balance
Bend the knees and arch the back, bringing the feet toward the head
Return to the balance

alignment: Lift the chest forward between the arms as the feet lower.
Keep the shoulders over the elbows (or wrists).
Lower the feet slowly with control.
modifications: Practice against a wall, walking the feet down.

steps.m: From Down Dog, lift into the forearm balance and lower into Shayanasana
Jump through; take the right foot behind the head and bind the hands behind the back
Jump through; left foot behind the head and bind

alignment: Rotate the thigh outward from the hip before taking the foot back.
Never pull on the knee.

kapilasana.meaning: Posture dedicated to the sage Kapila

steps.m: Jump through; take the right foot behind the head and bind
Fold forward over the extended leg
Come up
Jump through; take the left foot behind the head and bind
Fold forward
Come up

alignment: Keep the bind secure before folding.
Fold from the hips over the extended leg.

steps.m: Jump through; hold both big toes; draw the right foot back toward the right ear like drawing a bow
Release; draw the left foot toward the left ear

alignment: Keep the extended leg straight and grounded.
Lift the drawn foot up and back; keep the chest lifted.
Keep both sit bones grounded.

steps.m: Lower onto the belly; reach the hands back over the shoulders to hold the big toes, elbows pointing up; lift the chest and legs

alignment: Rotate the shoulders so the elbows point up.
Kick the feet up into the hands to lift.
Keep the knees from splaying apart.
modifications: Use a strap around the feet.

marichyasana-e-h.meaning: Postures dedicated to the sage Marichi
marichyasana-e-h.note: Four advanced variations of Marichyasana that combine lotus, binds and deeper twists. The details vary between teachers.

steps.m: Jump through; set up the variation on the right side and bind
Jump through; set up the variation on the left side and bind
Enter the posture
Enter the posture
Enter the arm balance
Enter the arm balance on the right side
Change to the left side
Jump through; hold the feet and rotate them up, drawing the soles to the navel; hands in prayer

alignment: Rotate from the hips, never forcing the knees or ankles.
Sit tall with the chest lifted.
modifications: Practice Baddha Konasana or Mula Bandhasana.
Hold the feet in front of the body without rotating them.

steps.m: From Samasthitih, drop back into Urdhva Dhanurasana
Kick up through handstand and over to standing; repeat as instructed
Come up to Samasthitih

alignment: Learn under supervision. This is a dynamic, committed movement.
Keep the arms straight and strong through the handstand.
Spread the backbend through the whole spine.
modifications: Practice drop backs to Urdhva Dhanurasana.
Kick over from Urdhva Dhanurasana with a teacher's support.

steps.m: From Samasthitih, arch back
Drop back and take hold of the calves or ankles
Come up to standing

alignment: Push the hips forward over the feet as you arch.
Walk the hands in toward the legs gradually.
Practice with a teacher's assistance.
modifications: Practice drop backs to Urdhva Dhanurasana.
Hold the hands on the thighs and arch partway.
